insights.name: Cluster health issues
insights.description: Checks for any cluster health issues that prevent successful upgrade to the next Kubernetes version on EKS.

insights.name: Deprecated APIs removed in Kubernetes v1.37
insights.description: Checks for usage of deprecated APIs that are scheduled for removal in Kubernetes v1.37. Upgrading your cluster before migrating to the updated APIs supported by v1.37 could cause application impact.

insightStatus.reason: No deprecated API usage detected within the last 30 days.

insights.name: kube-proxy version skew
insights.description: Checks version of kube-proxy in cluster to see if upgrade would cause non compliance with supported Kubernetes kube-proxy version skew policy.

insightStatus.reason: kube-proxy versions match the cluster control plane version.

insights.name: Kubelet version skew
insights.description: Checks for kubelet versions of worker nodes in the cluster to see if upgrade would cause non compliance with supported Kubernetes kubelet version skew policy.

insightStatus.reason: Node kubelet versions match the cluster control plane version.

insights.name: EKS add-on version compatibility
insights.description: Checks version of installed EKS add-ons to ensure they are compatible with the next version of Kubernetes.

insightStatus.reason: All installed EKS add-on versions are compatible with next Kubernetes version.

insights.name: Amazon Linux 2 compatibility
insights.description: Checks if any nodes in the cluster are running Amazon Linux 2. Support for Amazon Linux 2 on Amazon EKS will end on November 26, 2025. Additionally, Amazon EKS will not release Amazon Linux 2 AMIs for Kubernetes version 1.33 and higher

insightStatus.reason: Amazon EKS stopped publishing EKS-optimized Amazon Linux 2 (AL2) AMIs on November 26, 2025. AL2023 and Bottlerocket based AMIs for Amazon EKS are available for all supported Kubernetes versions including 1.33 and higher.

insights.name: Deprecated APIs removed in Kubernetes v1.38
insights.description: Checks for usage of deprecated APIs that are scheduled for removal in Kubernetes v1.38. Upgrading your cluster before migrating to the updated APIs supported by v1.38 could cause application impact.

insightStatus.reason: No deprecated API usage detected within the last 30 days.
